profile: Three years of customer support at a travel agency in Istanbul: around 40 calls and emails a day in Turkish and English about bookings, changes and cancellations, every case logged in Zendesk, and refunds and rebookings arranged with hotels and airlines. coverLetter:
Dear Bluewave Travel Services team,

I am applying for the Customer Support Specialist with Turkish role in Warsaw.

For three years I worked in customer support at a travel agency in Istanbul, answering around 40 calls and emails a day in Turkish and English about bookings, changes and cancellations. I logged every case in Zendesk and followed it up until it was closed, and I prepared refund and rebooking requests for hotels and airlines, which are the core tasks in your advert.

I live in Warsaw, hold a Polish residence card and can work the 8:00 to 20:00 shifts you describe.

Kind regards,
Ece Yildirim
